findingClass: an IPO the external market lists (chittorgarh.com's public dashboard) has no matching row on our site, or has one mistyped as offering_type != 'IPO' (the Mopshop shape), or its detail page 404s / renders a different company (the T-460 e_unknown_slug_404 shape) -- every OTHER check iterates OUR OWN rows and cannot find a row we never created
sourceTask: #187 (T-461), filed by T-297 discovery-coverage meta-analysis (D2 reverse sweep); real-world instance issue #351 (prod missing Karamtara Engineering/Infrax Renewable/Rentomojo/Manipal Payment/Steamhouse India/Vinod Texworld while staging had discovered several days earlier)
failThreshold: any chittorgarh.com dashboard IPO (mainboard + SME, OPEN/UPCOMING) fails any of: (a) a matching row exists on the target (slug, then normalized-name search, both compared with the trailing legal-entity suffix stripped), (b) that row's offeringType == 'IPO', (c) GET {BASE_URL}/ipos/<slug> returns 200 and the body mentions the company name
unverifiableWhen: the external calendar (both chittorgarh dashboard fetches) could not be reached at all -- BLIND, not a pass. NOTE: does not cover recently-CLOSED (30-day) IPOs -- chittorgarh's listing-date report renders client-side and ipowatch.in was unreachable from the environment this check was authored in; see scripts/lib/chittorgarh-oracle-parser.mjs 'KNOWN GAP'.
